func TestMigration023RejectsIndependentNonterminalWork(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name       string
		insertTurn bool
		want       string
	}{
		{name: "text turn without interaction link", insertTurn: true, want: "nonterminal onboarding turns must drain"},
		{name: "coordinator job without turn", want: "nonterminal onboarding coordinator jobs must drain"},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 22)
			studentID, teacherID := insertMigration023Teacher(t, pool)
			now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			eventID, jobID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
			_, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), `
INSERT INTO teacher_dialog_job (
 event_id,teacher_job_id,dialog_id,event_sequence,source_message_id,source_message_sequence,
 student_id,personal_teacher_id,context_type,occurred_at,status,next_attempt_at,accepted_at,updated_at,coordinator_mode
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1,$4,1,$5,$6,'general',$7,'queued',$7,$7,$7,'onboarding_text')
`, eventID, jobID, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), studentID, teacherID, now)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if testCase.insertTurn {
				_, err = pool.Exec(context.Background(), `
INSERT INTO teacher_onboarding_turn (
 teacher_job_id,source_event_id,interaction_id,coordinator_mode,stage,
 student_command_id,response_command_id,student_effect_state,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,NULL,'onboarding_text','received',$3,$4,'not_attempted',$5,$5)
`, jobID, eventID, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), now)
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}

			migration := migration023SQL(t, ".up.sql")
			_, err = pool.Exec(context.Background(), migration)
			require.ErrorContains(t, err, testCase.want)
		})
	}
}

func TestMigration023TerminalRepositoryConcurrencyFenceAndGuards(t *testing.T) {
	pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 23)
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID, teacherID := insertMigration023Teacher(t, pool)
	dialogID := uuid.NewString()
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	teacher := domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: teacherID, StudentID: studentID}
	first, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingActivePathTerminalSession(teacher, binding,
		domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second := first
	second.CreatedAt = second.CreatedAt.Add(time.Second)
	second.UpdatedAt = second.CreatedAt

	store := TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository{Pool: pool}
	start := make(chan struct{})
	results := make([]domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, 2)
	created := make([]bool, 2)
	errors := make([]error, 2)
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	for index, candidate := range []domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{first, second} {
		wait.Add(1)
		go func(index int, candidate domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) {
			defer wait.Done()
			<-start
			results[index], created[index], errors[index] = store.EnsurePending(ctx, candidate)
		}(index, candidate)
	}
	close(start)
	wait.Wait()
	require.NoError(t, errors[0])
	require.NoError(t, errors[1])
	require.Equal(t, results[0].ID, results[1].ID)
	require.NotEqual(t, created[0], created[1], "exact concurrent Ensure calls create once and replay once even when clocks differ")

	dialogMessageID := uuid.NewString()
	ackStart := make(chan struct{})
	ackErrors := make([]error, 2)
	for index := range ackErrors {
		wait.Add(1)
		go func(index int) {
			defer wait.Done()
			<-ackStart
			_, ackErrors[index] = store.MarkDelivered(ctx, first.ID, dialogMessageID, time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 9, 1, index, 0, time.UTC))
		}(index)
	}
	close(ackStart)
	wait.Wait()
	require.NoError(t, ackErrors[0])
	require.NoError(t, ackErrors[1], "a losing delivery CAS re-reads and accepts the exact acknowledgement")

	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_onboarding_terminal_session WHERE terminal_session_id=$1`, first.ID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "terminal session evidence cannot be deleted")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `TRUNCATE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session`)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "terminal session evidence cannot be deleted")
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, migration023SQL(t, ".down.sql"))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "terminal onboarding session evidence is retained permanently")
}

func TestTerminalActivePathCannotClosePromptWithEffectCapableReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	pool := migration023IntegrationPool(t, 23)
	ctx := context.Background()
	studentID, teacherID := insertMigration023Teacher(t, pool)
	dialogID, promptID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	body, ui, err := domain.BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepDirection, "en", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher,
		Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui,
		Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now,
	}, domain.OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, 3, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, _, err = (TeacherOnboardingTurnRepository{Pool: pool}).EnsureActiveInteraction(ctx, interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_interaction SET session_schema_version=2 WHERE interaction_id=$1`, interaction.ID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "session schema version is immutable")
	for _, version := range []any{nil, 4} {
		_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_onboarding_interaction (
 interaction_id,dialog_id,student_id,personal_teacher_id,prompt_message_id,prompt_message_version,
 prompt_assistant_ui_digest,slot_code,expected_draft_version,expected_profile_version,session_schema_version,state,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,1,$6,'direction_code',0,0,$7,'active',$8,$8)
`, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), studentID, teacherID, uuid.NewString(), strings.Repeat("f", 64), version, now)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "requires session schema version 1..3")
	}

	request := domain.AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: domain.AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: dialogID,
		MessageID: promptID, MessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v2",
		ActionID: "direction.backend", IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString()}
	receipt, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request, studentID, teacherID, uuid.NewString(), now.Add(time.Second), now.Add(time.Minute), domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	terminal, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingActivePathTerminalSession(domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: teacherID, StudentID: studentID}, binding,
		domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, now.Add(2*time.Second))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	start := make(chan struct{})
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	var claimErr, terminalErr error
	wait.Add(2)
	go func() {
		defer wait.Done()
		<-start
		_, _, claimErr = (OnboardingActionRepository{Pool: pool}).Claim(ctx, receipt)
	}()
	go func() {
		defer wait.Done()
		<-start
		_, _, terminalErr = (TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository{Pool: pool}).EnsurePending(ctx, terminal)
	}()
	close(start)
	wait.Wait()

	var state string
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT state FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction WHERE interaction_id=$1`, interaction.ID).Scan(&state))
	var terminalCount int
	require.NoError(t, pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_onboarding_terminal_session WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID).Scan(&terminalCount))
	if claimErr == nil {
		require.ErrorIs(t, terminalErr, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy)
		require.Equal(t, "active", state)
		require.Zero(t, terminalCount)
	} else {
		require.ErrorIs(t, claimErr, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict)
		require.NoError(t, terminalErr)
		require.Equal(t, "closed", state)
		require.Equal(t, 1, terminalCount)
	}
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, migration023SQL(t, ".down.sql"))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "stamped onboarding session evidence is retained permanently")
}

func migration023IntegrationPool(t *testing.T, maximum int) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()
	base := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	schema := "teacher_s11_migration_" + strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")
	quotedSchema := pgx.Identifier{schema}.Sanitize()
	_, err := base.Exec(ctx, "CREATE SCHEMA "+quotedSchema)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	config := base.Config().Copy()
	if config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams == nil {
		config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams = map[string]string{}
	}
	config.ConnConfig.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = schema
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, config)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		pool.Close()
		_, _ = base.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP SCHEMA "+quotedSchema+" CASCADE")
	})
	paths, err := migrationUpPathsThrough(migration019RepositoryRoot(t), maximum)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, path := range paths {
		sql, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, readErr, path)
		_, execErr := pool.Exec(ctx, string(sql))
		require.NoError(t, execErr, path)
	}
	return pool
}

func insertMigration023Teacher(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool) (string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	studentID, teacherID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 7, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	_, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), `
INSERT INTO personal_teacher (
 id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,
 hint_policy,intervention_mode,version,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,'s11-integration','en','direct','scaffold','scaffold','manual',1,$3,$3)
`, teacherID, studentID, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return studentID, teacherID
}

func migration023SQL(t *testing.T, suffix string) string {
	t.Helper()
	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(migration019RepositoryRoot(t), "db", "migrations", "023_teacher_onboarding_session_contract"+suffix))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return string(content)
}
